NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
AT 3354 SOUTH WALLACE STREET

The Application on behalf of the current property Owners, Mr. Hongjun Chen, and Ms. Jiajia He, is
for a Zoning Map Amendment to RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhome and Multi-Unit District for
purposes of constructing a two-dwelling unit building on this currently vacant lot.

The proposed Building will be two (2) stories in height plus partial lower level. The Owners’ unit on
1st and 2"4 floor will contain four (4) bedrooms in duplex up layout and separate lower level (Garden) unit
with three (3) bedrooms.

The Application is filed under 17-17-0100-A as a Type 1 filing. The footprint of the building is 21’ 8”
x 66,0 feet and shall be approximately 1,436 square feet. The building height shall be 28 fect and 1% inches,
as defined by City Code.
